propositions: The comment-id dedup map `comment_ids` was inert/empty, causing the outbound comment sync to re-post duplicate comments on every hourly reconcile pass.
REB-1861 reached Jira's 5000-comment hard cap with 4921 duplicates; 30 issues total accumulated 30,011 duplicates across 31,683 total comments.

Duplicate comments are identified by the presence of `RECONCILER_MARKER` in pre-strip rendered ADF text and grouped by `_normalize_comment_body` for dedup; keep-oldest-per-group deletion removes 29,931 duplicates while preserving exactly one copy of each distinct body.

836 comments across three issues (REB-1567, REB-1931, REB-2605) lack the marker due to outbound truncation at 32767 chars cutting off the marker paragraph; these are phase-2 candidates behind `--include-truncated` and were deliberately not deleted.
Post-execution verification confirms all 27 backed-up issues have zero missing distinct bodies, unchanged non-candidate counts, and no duplicate survivors; REB-1861 reduced from 5000 to 79 comments.
